reason: This PR looks central and risky enough for a deeper pass. It changes the ANALYZE write path across executor and statistics code, plus planner/session surfaces (`planbuilder`, sysvars, bootstrap upgrade), with the explicit goal of stopping v1 stats writes. That can affect statistics persistence, auto-analyze behavior, global/partition stats, upgrade compatibility, and optimizer cost/cardinality inputs across the system. The scope is broad rather than a local bug fix, and regressions here could cause widespread plan-quality or compatibility failures.
